text: Westport Albion's Marek Zielinski intercepts the ball just inside his own half, around 62 metres from the Kingsmoor FC goal. He passes short to Jonah Valdez, who carries the ball forward along the right flank, moving into the final third. Valdez then passes to Dylan Rahman near the right edge of the penalty area, who delivers a low cross into the six-metre box. Valdez meets the cross with a header close to the goal, but Westport Albion’s goalkeeper, Tariq Brennan, reacts quickly to make a fine save near the near post. The score remains Kingsmoor FC 2, Westport Albion 3. [#1464] [#1465] [#1466] [#1467] [#1468] [#1469] [#1470] [#1471]
